newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Albania's first Roman Catholic cardinal dies.
newsitem.headline: Albania's first Roman Catholic cardinal dies.

text.p: Cardinal Mikel Koliqi, Albania's first Roman Catholic primate, died on Tuesday aged 94, Albanian television reported.
Koliqi, who was persecuted for his faith under the former hardline communist regime and spent 37 years in jail, died after a long illness, the television said. It gave no further details.

Albania, under the Stalinist rule of late dictator Enver Hoxha, was officially declared an atheist state in 1967. Hundreds of Catholic, Orthodox and Moslem clergy were arrested and jailed or sentenced to hard labour in internal exile.
A reformist communist government lifted the ban on freedom of worship in November 1990. Albania is a predominantly Moslem country, with Greek Orthodox and Roman Catholic communities.
